description: The entity does not implement policies and procedures over system processing to result in products, services, and reporting to meet the entity's product or service specifications.

metadata.detection_notes: Review data processing procedures, transformation logic, quality controls during processing, reconciliation processes, and error handling. Check for absence of processing controls, validation during processing, or quality assurance measures.
